rv.q: Studio has once again proven that thoughtful curation paired with bold creative choices can yield an experience that lingers long after the final bow.
Hence, Purlie Victorious , set in the Old South of the 1950s, and written by the great Ossie Davis during the height of the Civil Rights Movement, feels as fresh as your morning news.
"Purlie Victorious" is charmingly impactful in every way.
This is a great production, of a brilliant play. You will not want to miss seeing it.
Psalmayene 24’s “Purlie Victorious” is freshly laundered, updated and ready for a night out on the town.
After more than 50 years, the play holds up because the writing is funny, the actors are superb and, most of all, it inspires us with its focus on flawed humans seeking community and freedom.

cn.t: Critics praise this revival as a potently funny satire that skewers racism with sharp humor and strong performances, finding the 1961 play still resonates today with its entertaining yet pointed social commentary.
